Docs: "In the `arb` files, the key of each entry is used as the method name of the getter, while the value of that entry contains the localized message." Options table: `template-arb-file` "The template arb file that is used as the basis for generating the Dart localization and messages files." `arb-dir` "The directory where the template and translated arb files are located."

app_localizations.dart@stage-2: localizationsDelegates = [delegate, GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate, GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate, GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate]; supportedLocales = [Locale('en'), Locale('vi')]. Docs option `preferred-supported-locales`: "By default, the tool generates the supported locales list in alphabetical order." flutter_tools gen_l10n.dart:1136 `_allBundles.locales.toList()..sort()`. l10n.yaml sets no preferred-supported-locales.

Docs: "If a user's preferred locale isn't specified, Flutter selects the closest match ... Headless Chrome on lab /login: accept-lang vi,en -> Đăng nhập; en,vi -> Sign in; fr -> Sign in. Round-1 probe: [fr]->en, [vi,en_US,en]->vi.

Docs `nullable-getter`: "If this value is false, then a null check is performed on the returned value of `Localizations.of(context)`, removing the need for null checking in user code." Docs: "The Localizations widget defines the locale for its child and the localized resources that the child depends on."

issues.text: Overstated inference. The page is Vietnamese whenever Vietnamese comes before English in the list, not only when it is first: Chrome list [French, Vietnamese, English] also resolves to vi (round-1 probe [fr,vi,en] -> vi). A reader in that case would think Vietnamese is first and 'move English to the top' still works, so the step's outcome is unaffected.
issues.quote: If they are already in Vietnamese, Vietnamese is first in your list
issues.fix: Write "If they are already in Vietnamese, Vietnamese comes before English in your list".
